blocks.text: A range of disorders can affect the respiratory system and interfere with respiration. These respiratory disorders can range from mild and self-limiting conditions such as the common cold to more severe diseases such as sinusitis, otitis media, pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, emphysema and COPD.
